author: Jeff Gamet
title: Apple’s Stock Up Over $203, Inching Closer to $1 Trillion Market Cap
text:
$205.65 as I make this comment. Keep climbing AAPL! Vote Up 0 Vote Down Member RonMacGuy
Hi Lee. It’s been a long time!! Yes, Keep climbing AAPL!! Good thing we didn’t sell all those years ago when our dear friend Bosco told us to sell at $250 a share (pre-split) as Apple would be faltering and never rising again!! Hee Hee. Vote Up 1 Vote Down Member Lee Dronick
Oh yeah, I am glad that I didn’t sell. Do you think we will soon see another stock split? Vote Up 0 Vote Down Member RonMacGuy
My personal thoughts are, probably not for a while. With the stock buy-backs, I can see them holding off on the split unless share price continues to skyrocket. But, I suspect that even with good news quarterly, until Apple releases something truly new and exciting, stock price may stop increasing. I do still hold out hope that they have secretly been working the Apple Car in very top secret fashion, which would be a complete game changer from a stock perspective.
